label: c0-as7-ps3-patch-members

specimen.identity: the copy's own PARAM.SFO (TITLE NHL Legacy, TITLE_ID BLUS31540, APP_VER 01.01) as recorded by C0-POR1 for this copy; patch.big sits at USRDIR root beside options.viv

limitations: A member table read through the reader's name and directory tables. Names are the literal NUL-terminated ASCII strings those tables hold; nothing is inferred or hashed.

`stored_magic` is the first eight bytes at each entry's stored offset, labelled by the magics the reader documents. It is an observation of the stored form, not a decode, and not a codec claim for the bytes behind the magic.

`decoded_form` is what `eb::decode_payload` did with the stored bytes: `raw` passed them through, `chunkzip` inflated them through the committed codec, `chunklzx-unsupported` means the codec is not implemented and no decoded identity exists. A successful inflate is an observation about these bytes and this codec; it establishes no target-wide codec.

Loose-file cells compare a decoded member with whatever sits at the same relative path (and its `.bak` sibling) under the loose root at read time. `loose_present = false` means the OS reported NotFound; the root was validated as a readable directory first, and any other read failure aborts the run before a record is written. Equality is a content observation; it says nothing about which of the two the game loads.
`word_4` and `word_12` are the file-table words the reader does not interpret (the latter documented as an unidentified per-entry checksum). Recorded verbatim.
`decode_error` is the committed codec's own error text where `decoded_form` is `decode-error`; it records that THIS codec did not inflate THESE bytes and nothing about why the bytes are as they are.

Nothing was written or extracted; decoded bytes were hashed in memory and dropped. The record establishes no installation rule, runtime binding or precedence between archives or between an archive and a loose file.
The copy's identity is the one the specimen field cites; a title id plus an archive version tag is not a build.
